name: stock-scanner
description: Runs the Go backend and the React front end together.

scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && go run ./cmd/scanner
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "go run ./cmd/scanner" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && go build ./cmd/scanner
scripts.test: go test ./... && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
